title: fleet growth scenarios and bom estimator 2026
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet outlines three fleet growth scenarios (conservative, steady, aggressive) for Private/VPC GPU deployments across regions. It provides a compact BOM estimator at rack/node level, utilization assumptions, and quick unit-cost outputs to feed pricing and procurement conversations. Intended for early architecture reviews and customer scoping calls; not a finalized procurement quote.

Key assumptions (editable):
- Target model mix: 60% medium-context LLMs (<= 4k tokens), 30% long-context LLMs (<= 32k tokens), 10% heavy fine-tuning/embedding jobs.
- GPU SKUs considered: H100-80GB, A100-80GB, L40S-48GB (for cost-optimized tiers).
- Baseline operating utilization = 55% (avg token-serving time slice across day). Peak day utilization target = 85% (short bursts).
- NVMe per GPU node: 2 x 3.84TB by default; option to double for on-prem stateful workloads.
- Network: 200GbE top-of-rack standard; 400GbE optional for high-throughput inference.
- Rack power budget: 30kW per rack (supports up to 8 H100 nodes depending on config).
- Spare capacity buffer: 10% reserved for failover/maintenance.

How to use this sheet (quick):
1) Set region growth rates and initial customer RPS/Tokens-per-second in the Inputs block.
2) Choose preferred GPU SKU per region (cost vs perf).
3) Select scenario: conservative (low growth), steady (product-market-fit), aggressive (high growth).
4) Review per-region racks and total BOM (GPUs, chassis, switches, PSUs, rails, kitting).
5) Export summary to pricing template for procurement.

Inputs (example values):
- Initial global steady RPS (text gen): 1,200 requests/sec
- Avg tokens per response: 120 tokens
- Token processing throughput per GPU (est): H100-80GB = 28k tokens/sec, A100-80GB = 22k tokens/sec, L40S-48GB = 14k tokens/sec
- Customer regional split: us-west: 40%, eu-west: 35%, ap-south: 25%
- Monthly growth rate (steady): us-west 6%, eu-west 4%, ap-south 10%
- Planning horizon: 18 months

Calculator logic (text formulas):
- Region demand at month m = initial_region_demand * (1 + monthly_growth_rate)^(m-1)
- Tokens/sec per region = region_RPS * avg_tokens_per_response
- Effective GPU capacity at target utilization = token_throughput_per_gpu * target_utilization (e.g., 28k * 0.55 = 15.4k tokens/sec usable)
- GPUs required per region = ceil( (tokens/sec per region) / effective_gpu_capacity ) * (1 + spare_buffer%)
- Nodes required = ceil(gpus_required / gpus_per_node) (we assume 4 GPUs/node for dense chassis; option for 8-GPU nodes added in alternatives)
- Racks = ceil(nodes_required / nodes_per_rack) (default nodes_per_rack = 6 for full-depth racks)

Scenarios (first 6 months snapshot, condensed):
- Conservative (lower growth, higher cost-savings SKU mix):
  - SKU preference: mix 50% A100, 50% L40S in ap-south; H100 reserved for us-west only for latency-critical workloads.
  - Result (month 6): us-west: 18 GPUs (3 nodes), eu-west: 14 GPUs (4 nodes), ap-south: 10 GPUs (3 nodes). Total racks = 4.
  - Observations: lower capital outlay but limited headroom for sudden spike (plan for pre-warm strategy).

- Steady (balanced):
  - SKU preference: H100 primary in us-west & eu-west; A100 in ap-south for cost balance.
  - Result (month 6): us-west: 28 GPUs (8 nodes), eu-west: 22 GPUs (6 nodes), ap-south: 18 GPUs (5 nodes). Total racks = 6.
  - Observations: good baseline for SLA-backed customers; spare buffer consumes ~10% of capacity.

- Aggressive (fast growth, headroom focused):
  - SKU preference: H100 everywhere (prioritize performance), extra 10% spare in each region.
  - Result (month 6): us-west: 42 GPUs (11 nodes), eu-west: 34 GPUs (9 nodes), ap-south: 30 GPUs (8 nodes). Total racks = 10.
  - Observations: higher TCO but lowers risk of throttling/fallback; increases power and network planning complexity.

BOM estimator (unit line items, approximate list price/unit placeholders):
- H100-80GB GPU: $35,000 each
- A100-80GB GPU: $12,500 each
- L40S-48GB GPU: $8,500 each
- 4x GPU chassis (4x H100-capable): $45,000 per chassis (includes NVMe, basic NIC)
- Dense 8x GPU node (8x A100): $80,000 per node (use when rack power allows)
- Top-of-rack 200GbE switch: $18,000 each
- 400GbE uplink optics/module (per rack): $6,000
- 3.84TB NVMe (x2 per node): $1,100 each
- Rack power distribution and PDUs: $3,500 per rack
- Rack (cabinets + rails + basic kitting): $4,500 per rack
- KVM + console + cabling kit: $2,200 per rack
- Installation & test labor (est): 12 hours per rack @ $150/hr = $1,800

Example cost summary (steady scenario month 6):
- GPUs: 28 + 22 + 18 = 68 GPUs (mix H100/A100 per region). Rough GPU cost = $1,220,000 (mixed estimate).
- Chassis/nodes: 20 nodes ~ $1,200,000
- Networking + racks + misc: $220,000
- Installation and spare parts: $75,000
- Estimated capex total (ex tax/shipping): $2.7M (rounded)

Operational considerations to include in scoping notes:
- Power capacity and site PUE differences by region (use a factor 1.2 for non-US sites unless confirmed).
- Lead times: H100 typical lead 8–14 weeks; plan alternate procurement for critical path.
- Refresh cadence: 36 months assumed; include spare GPU pool for hot-swap (5% of fleet).
- Warranty & depot replacement: assume 3-year NBD with on-site swap for enterprise deals.
- Security: ensure closed-network imaging and HSM/KMS integration for Private deployments.

Risk register (short):
- Supply risk on H100 increases timeline -> mitigations: pre-orders, use A100 fallback images.
- Under/over-provisioning mismatch -> mitigations: staged ship + canary capacity, burst routes to hosted API.
- Power/cooling mismatch discovered at site -> mitigations: pre-deployment power dry-run, holdback budget for chillers.

Notes / open questions for next sync:
- Confirm preferred GPU SKU with customer procurement (affects lead times and capex).
- Agree on on-prem network topology: spine-leaf or flat TOR? (affects switch counts and optics).
- Decide whether to standardize on 4-GPU nodes vs 8-GPU for long-term ops simplicity.
- Validate PUE assumptions with datacenter partner for ap-south region.

Appendix (quick formulas for copy):
- monthly_growth_factor = 1 + monthly_growth_rate
- region_tokens_m = initial_region_tokens * monthly_growth_factor^(m-1)
- gpus_required = ceil(region_tokens_m / (gpu_tokens_per_sec * target_utilization)) * (1 + spare_buffer_pct)
- nodes_required = ceil(gpus_required / gpus_per_node)

Revision log (notes):
- 2025-11-12: initial draft (Aisha)
- 2025-12-08: added realistic SKU prices and example outputs (Diego)
- 2026-01-20: updated growth rates and steady-scenario costs after procurement feedback (Evelyn)

(End of sheet)
